props.name: text
props.description: The passage. Split on whitespace, so punctuation stays attached.

props.name: as
props.description: Element for the passage. Use a heading level where one is right.

props.name: scrollRef
props.description: Scroll container. Defaults to the window.

props.name: span
props.description: How much of the pass is spent lighting words, 0–1. Lower finishes sooner.

props.name: softness
props.description: How many words are mid-fade at once.

props.name: dimClassName
props.description: Colour of a word that has not been reached.
